## Operation statuses

`completed`, `no_dispatchable_step`, `paused_for_review`, `round_executed`, `step_executed`, `step_failed`, `transition_not_authorized`

## Halt reasons

`dispatch_in_progress`, `needs_evidence`, `needs_external`, `needs_plan_review`, `needs_retry_decision`, `needs_review`, `nothing_eligible`, `round_budget_exhausted`

`evaluation_failed`, `existing_case_space`, `gate_violation`, `invalid`, `io_error`, `lock_unavailable`, `missing_case_space`, `stale_plan_revision`, `stale_revision`, `store_integrity`, `store_io`, `unsupported_schema`, `usage`, `worker_error`
